text_block_list.name: Mochifiend Gummy
text_block_list.text:
Persevering over your own impure desires is an impressive feat...
But how will you fare against them all at once?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マサカ、
ボンノウヲ、
ウチヤブルナンテ……
ナラバ、
スベテノボンノウヲ、
アツメテヤル……！

text_block_list.name: Mochifiend Gummy
text_block_list.text:
Behold!
You humans are tainted! Corrupted beyond no comparison!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミセテヤルゾ！
オマエラ、
ニンゲンノケガレタココロヲ……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
All of our desires at once?
Wait, is it actually going to bring out all 108 of them?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
全てのボンノウ……？
ひょっとして、
108のボンノウを全部ここに呼び出すの！？

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it wants to play, is it?
This battle's only going to get tougher, but it doesn't matter.
We can't afford to give up, no matter what!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど、
そうきたか……
ここからは更に厳しい戦いだ。
どんな相手でも、
決して諦めずに戦おう！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I dunno much about all this impure desire stuff,
but punching them seems to work! I'll stick to that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オッケー！　
ボンノウのことはよくわかんないけど、
とにかくやっつけちゃおう！　
やるぞぉーっ！！
